prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create a high-detail professional ENVIRONMENT CONCEPT SHEET for the original science-fiction RTS Echoes of the Broken Sun. Landscape format. Large elevated three-quarter tactical scene occupies the upper 70%, THREE separate labeled environmental detail studies along the bottom 25%, tasteful clean ivory header and narrow separators. This is illustrated production concept art, not a UI screenshot, photomontage, vector diagram or executable map. Believable sculptural surfaces, visible thickness, joints, support, purposeful weathering; refined painterly realism. Tactical view must make calm usable ground and route silhouettes readable before decoration. Sparse background atmosphere, no lens flare. Charcoal basalt and vitrified black, pale ceramic civic forms, controlled broken-sun amber, quiet cyan status fixtures; magenta only for fracture/Choir signals. No generic fantasy temples, skulls, giant neon crystals, lush Earth forests, giant mountains dominating the playfield, or faction armies. Avoid busy microtexture across walkable lanes. Do not invent a new interactable hazard or objective.
When a Future Well reference is supplied, it is identity reference ONLY: use the DORMANT low basalt bowl and single small dark central spire, never other active states, infographic labels or giant crystals. Original landform references are material/ecology references ONLY; do not duplicate their old placeholder buildings, creatures, rune marks or composition.
Header text: "ECHOES OF THE BROKEN SUN". Then the map code and short place name given below. Footer text: "ENVIRONMENT CONCEPT • CANDIDATE • COMPOSITION STUDY". Minimal clear typography, no other paragraphs. Bottom details should be large useful close studies; exactly three panels with the requested short labels. The scene may reuse instances, but the detail designs remain individually identifiable.

Map: "SK02 — Twin-ridge skirmish basin". Mission: Crownfall Basin.
Main scene: An elevated near-top-down tactical environment of a compact square basin with twin NORTH-SOUTH dark ridges, north and south shelf walls, and exactly THREE EAST-WEST gate corridors through the ridge system: north gate, middle gate, south gate. Clear west and east home shelves, near expansions, broad clean routes. One small dormant Future Well offset NORTH of center. Eight modest cyan-white Matter deposits: two home, two near expansions, four contested. Collapsed old civic foundations are embedded in outer cliffs, with pale-tide-polished geological gate walls. No vertical fantasy city; strategically readable rugged basin.
Bottom detail panels left to right:
1. "Foundation cliff" — Weathered pale-ceramic civic foundation embedded in black layered cliff, no new destructible bridge.
2. "Pale-tide gate wall" — Smooth chalk-pale mineral polish on a dark basalt gate wall, dry stable route floor, no liquid hazard.
3. "Matter seam" — Small cyan-white mineral deposit nested into a matte rock shoulder, crisp silhouette and limited glow.
Specific exclusions: No extra gate, blocked required gate, central Well instead of north-offset, flood hazard, damage aura, faction bases or invented tide mechanics.
Evidence boundary (inform composition, do not print paragraph): SPEC-SKM-012 composition study; resource counts and gate topology must be bound and verified in later authored map data.
Material separation reminder: where GROWN MINERAL is requested it must have continuous stratified, root-like load paths with no brick masonry and no cyan machinery. Where CIVIC CERAMIC is requested it uses engineered joints and serviceable fittings. Do not flatten these into one generic architecture. Neutral observation stone is simple worked rock with no electronic terminal unless expressly requested.
